text:
US buybacks are set to rise to unprecedented levels:

US buyback authorizations are up +13% YoY so far in 2026, to a record $1.305 trillion.

Buyback authorizations are now on track for their 4th consecutive annual increase, the longest such streak in at least 20 years.

Since the 2020 low, buyback authorizations have more than quadrupled.

Meanwhile, executed buybacks grew +20% YoY in Q2 2026, their largest increase since Q1 2025.

This also marks the 4th consecutive quarterly increase, with H1 2026 up +15% year-over-year.

We expect a large wave of US stock buybacks ahead.

text:
BREAKING: The total value of the US stock market has surged to 350% of the US M2 money supply, the highest level since the 2000 Dot-Com Bubble.

Since the 2022 bear market, this ratio has surged +170 percentage points.

Over this period, the S&P 500 has rallied +118%, while M2 has risen +9%.

In other words, the stock market's gain has outpaced the money supply growth by 13x.

The last time equity market growth exceeded M2 growth by a larger amount was from 1995 to 1999.

Asset owners are winning.

name: Bearly AI
zh_summary: (Reposted by @TrungTPhan) @bearlyai：Cloudflare技術長Dane Knecht表示這家5000人公司將招聘1000名實習生，因AI原生實習生促使主管更快採用AI；兩年前約200名。$NET
en_summary: (Reposted by @TrungTPhan) @bearlyai: Cloudflare CTO Dane Knecht says they are hiring 1,000 interns for a 5,000 person company because AI native interns made managers adopt AI faster, up from about 200 interns two years ago. $NET
text:
Cloudflare CTO Dane Knecht says they are hiring 1,000 interns for a 5,000-person company because AI-native interns made their managers adopt AI faster:

“Two years ago we had about 200 interns, and what we saw was those interns were really the first fully AI native. If you took AI away from them, I don't think they would be able to work.

I think they know how to use the tools better than us. It's just like if you took Google away from me over the last 10 years, how would I learn anything? That's where they reach first. And we actually saw the managers that had interns that summer adopt AI faster.

So this past year, we decided we're going to hire a thousand interns. For a 5,000 person company. Over the course of the year.

It's just been amazing, because of the number of ideas that come from the interns. With AI, fewer people experiment faster, so having more ideas is great. And just seeing the way they use AI: they need to fill out a form, they reach for AI. And I still find myself, there are so many things where I'm like, 'Oh wait, I've just been doing this manually still.'”

zh_summary: 邁克爾·西坎德在其不對稱押注組閤中以每股190美元加倉 $BE，佔16%倉位。他此前於12月以90美元買入並於6月以274美元賣出，獲利186%。客戶預付款從年初約1.45億美元激增至約7.5億美元，顯示對Bloom產能的強勁需求。他認為能源是比記憶體更具結構性的長期交易，因此換出 $SNDK，並增加對近期大幅下跌的 $INTC、$NBIS、$CRDO 及 $LITE 的配置。該組合儘管過去一個月回撤20%，但全期仍上漲超過50%。
en_summary: Michael Sikand added $BE at $190/share as a 16% position in his Asymmetric Bets portfolio. He previously bought at $90 in December and sold at $274 for a 186% gain in June. Customer deposits surged to roughly $750 million from about $145 million at the start of the year, signaling strong demand for Bloom’s capacity. He swapped out $SNDK, viewing energy as a more structural long-term trade than memory, and increased allocations to $INTC, $NBIS, $CRDO, and $LITE which are down significantly. The portfolio is up over 50% all-time despite a 20% drawdown in the past month.
text:
$BE under $200? This market is full of pansies!

Just added $BE at $190/share in my ultra concentrated Asymmetric Bets portfolio as a 16% position.

What's interesting is I already made 186% on this stock earlier this year. You can look and see I added the stock at $90 in December and sold it for a 186% gain at $274/share on June 1.

Many remember my YouTube video where I explained the thesis and origin story of the company before this became a consensus energy winner.

Now I'm back in, especially after another record setting earnings. What stood out most to me was customer deposits surging to roughly $750 million from about $145 million at the start of the year, a clear sign customers are paying upfront to lock in Bloom’s capacity before it’s even built.

New positions often require sacrifices though. So I chose to swap out $SNDK in the portfolio. The rationale is simple. I see energy as being a more structural trade than memory. $BE is a stock I can hold for 10 years while $SNDK and memory has an uphill battle to prove to investors it has long term durability. 

I also used cash to bump up my allocations on $INTC, $NBIS, $CRDO, and $LITE. All are down huge in the last two weeks.

This portfolio is up over 50% all time despite being down 20% in the past month because I was early to AI infrastructure stocks before the herd. 

Tough drawdown, but have to stay focused on the best companies in this buildout.

en_summary: @KobeissiLetter: the premium for calls over puts on longer dated Treasuries is up to about 50 bps, the highest since March 2025, reversing a 250 bp put premium in late September, as investors bet on further Treasury gains.
text:
Investors are betting on more upside in US Treasuries.

The extra cost investors are willing to pay for call options on longer-dated Treasuries relative to puts is up to ~50 basis points, the highest since March 2025.

This marks a sharp reversal from a 250-basis-point premium for puts over calls in late September.

This suggests investors are increasingly betting on further gains in Treasury prices.

Furthermore, one options trade is targeting a drop in the 10Y Note Yield to ~4.60% within a month, involving ~65,000 contracts and costing ~$7 million in premium.

This comes as the 10Y Note Yield has declined below 5.00% for the first time since September 23rd, now down -40 basis points from the October 7th peak.

The bond market is seeing massive swings in price and sentiment.

ticker_notes.CCI: 因SPCX潛在成為大型運營商而上漲9%，新租戶為鐵塔帶來純利潤

zh_summary: 邁克爾·西坎德指出，$CCI 今日上漲9%，因為 $SPCX 可能成為下一個大型無線運營商。$SPCX 據稱希望至少擁有8萬個美國蜂窩站點，大約相當於 $CCI 和 $AMT 擁有的所有美國鐵塔總和。在已建成的鐵塔上增加新租戶幾乎是長期合約加上每年價格上調的純利潤。有趣的是看到市場對 $SPCX 進入電信業的重視程度。
en_summary: Michael Sikand notes $CCI is up 9% today because $SPCX could be the next big wireless carrier. $SPCX reportedly wants at least 80,000 U.S. cell sites, about every U.S. tower $CCI and $AMT own combined. Adding a new tenant on already built towers is almost pure profit on long contracts with yearly price bumps. Interesting to see how seriously the market takes $SPCX's entry into telecom.
text:
$CCI is up 9% today because $SPCX could be the next next big wireless carrier. 

$SPCX reportedly wants at least 80,000 U.S. cell sites which is about every U.S. tower $CCI and $AMT own combined.

Towers are already built so adding a new tenant is almost pure profit on long contracts with yearly price bumps. Interesting to see how seriously the market is taking $SPCX's entry into telecom.
